admin_address.description: Administrator's e-mail address for quarantine messages and site-wide policy contact.

admin_name.description: The full name of the administrator associated with $AdminAddress.

daemon_address.description: E-mail address from which MIMEDefang quarantine warnings and user notifications appear to come.

add_warnings_inline.description: If set to 1, MIMEDefang tries to add warnings directly in the message body rather than a separate MIME part.

syslog_facility.description: Syslogging facility to use for virus and spam activity (e.g., 'mail', 'local4').

syslog_per_recipient.description: If 1, produces a line of output for each recipient; if 0, only a single summary line for all recipients.

no_multiple_inlines.description: Set to 1 if your mail client cannot handle multiple 'inline' parts.

spam_max_size_kb.description: Maximum message size in KB to be scanned by SpamAssassin. Larger messages are skipped to avoid slow processing.
